notes.title: Assault Spy Update (October 23rd, 2020)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Hope y'all have been doing well! Wazen has been hard at work again with some bug fixes, balance changes, and adjustments to Assault Spy. 

Build ID: 5664801

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed: Amelia's "Shot" attack triggering by using other attack buttons
Fixed: Holding “Down” during Asaru's umbrella attack would change to Rush Hour's ASAP slash
 - Changed to a thrusting attack using the Umbrella
Fixed: Character specific keybindings would not be taken into account when switching characters
 - Character keybinding settings can be changed during their respective story line or after selecting that character in the title menu
Fixed: Gravity correction not working after character landing
Fixed: Amelia's Comet Straight would not trigger while holding a Charge Shot
Fixed: Armor time did not increase while continuously blocking with Amelia

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
Adjusted: Reduced the chance Droneman will escape from players
Adjusted: Reduced number of traps in the “Underground” stage
Adjusted: Expanded the floor in some areas of the “Rooftop” stage

Balanced: Lowered armor amount for Proto Officer
Balanced: Lowered HP amount for Big Monitor Man
Balanced: ??? boss, amount of enemies spawned greatly decreased
Balanced: ??? boss, time limit increased, damage done to boss slightly decreased

Balanced Amelia: Comet Straight's gravity 
Balanced Amelia: Normal combo and "Star Combination" speed increased
Balanced Amelia: "Braver Outburst" fills more Special Gauge
Balanced Amelia: Decreased the armor time for "Braver" skills
Balanced Amelia: Dash and jump times were shortened after blocking 
 - Can now immediately cancel with dash when block is successful
Added: Highlight to the Special gauge
Added: During Amelia's super state, enemy attacks will be nullified
Added: Amelia's gun attacks can be cancelled with “Dash”
Added: Amelia's block can be cancelled with "Dash" after a successful block

Added: Damage done accumulates during Overclock and releases when Overclock ends
Added: On/off option for outline effect in the “Quality” settings

Removed: Super armor for Coneman (no damage reaction)


As always, if there are any issues or questions, feel free to let us know through the Steam Community forums, or on our public [url=discord.gg/nisa]Discord[/url]!

Stay safe,
Daniel

notes.title: Assault Spy Update (August 19th, 2020)
notes.content:
Heyo!

As always, I hope everyone is staying safe. Wazen has been working on general bug fixes for Assault Spy, and we've updated it to Build ID: 5428740

[list]
[*] Added an outline effect to the characters
[*] Tweaked background drawing effect
[*] Timing for when cancelling is possible during Asaru's overclock has been sped up.
[*] Fixed bug where Asaru can use skills he has not yet obtained yet.
[*] Amelia's rapid kick has been changed to repeat hit skill and added a finishing move.
[*] Amelia's GM blast buster command changed (controller default settings RB+LB)
[*] Amelia's GM blast buster changed to hit more than one enemy.
[*] Fixed bug where cancel wouldn't work after Amelia's Ebon Thunder skill.
[*] Area range for Amelia's last attack for Super repel smash has been increased.
[*] Elite step and Agent step’s gravity reduction will recover slightly.
[*] Fixed stages that had effect camera’s embedded into walls.
[*] Fixed bug where the attack button would not respond after pressing pause after the stealth stage’s fight start message.
[*] Fixed bug where Kanoko’s assist could not be used after playing the ???mode.
[*] Fixed all bosses' triggers and movement direction for evasion.
[*] Fixed all bosses AI getting rigid.
[*] Tweaked Mr. Asault’s skills
[*] Tweaked Armor Monitor’s hit area
[*] Fixed bug where repeated hit skills would not take a one pattern penalty.
[*] Added function to change difficulty for training mode.
[*] Changed offset effect for attacks
[*] Fixed sound crackling when Sound effects would play over each other/play repeatedly.
[*] Fixed bug where lens flare would appear where there shouldn’t be one.
[*] Fixed bug where target would be stuck if you do not defeat the security cameras in the underground stage.
[*] Fixed bug where in extra mode after you fight Kanoko, in the main game you weren't able to use Kanoko assist
[*] Fixed sound issues where the noise would crack
[/list]

If there's any questions regarding the update or if you run into any problems, always feel free to let us know :)

Stay safe,
Daniel

notes.title: BIG Assault Spy Update (July 2nd, 2020)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Hope you're all staying safe during these times. 

Wazen has been working hard on adding extra content and bugfixes!

Here's a full list:
"★" = Larger update/bugfix

[h1]Added:[/h1]

★Added ??? in Extra Mode (hidden boss Kanoko)
This fight becomes available after clearing Asaru and Amelia’s modes on the Hard Work difficulty.
If you’ve met the prerequisites, then a message will appear after the ending (only once).
Once you’ve cleared the fight, your results will be recorded and displayed on your title menu. The results will not be made public.

・Added hidden skill for Asaru (Assault Bartitsu, transitions to Aerial Bartitsu)

[h1]Large updates/fixes:[/h1]
★Cloud save has been enabled.
・Bosses on Easy difficulty have more HP
★Fixed a bug where the story mode's difficulty would revert to Normal when playing Extra Modes.
★Adjusted and extended the length of extra time items in Extra Mode.
・Fixed a bug where vibration would still occur, despite being turned off in the options.
★Fixed Amelia's Ebon Thunder to prevent duds.
・Asaru's Straight skill’s hit area expanded and command reception tuned.
・Added a visual effect to Asaru's Just Timing.
・Dash Jump height and weight adjusted.
★Tweaked the radius in which recovery items will be obtained.
・Adjusted low/high differences for the lock-on camera so it's easier to see.
・Increased Officer Diamond’s HP.
・Reduced the invincibility period after taking a hit.
・Asaru's ASAP Slash’s distance has been tweaked.

[h1]Other:[/h1]
・Fixed a bug where Elite Step and Agent Step were not registering and added an effect.
・Added a smoke effect to jumps and other such movements. 
★Added BGM to Extra mode boss enemies.
・Fixed a bug where the character would not face the enemy when throwing business cards.
・Removed a short cutscene before Officer Diamond.
・Fixed the collision area of Armored Cone's hurricane attack.
★Fixed the LB RB button guide screenshots in the tutorial.
・Fixed a bug where enemies with 0 life would die when switching characters.
★Fixed camera zoom sticking when switching out characters.
・Fixed a bug where the first hit wouldn’t count toward results when switching characters.
・Fixed a bug where the player would lose the target on an enemy when switching characters.
★Voice actor’s name size fixed.
★Changed a portion of the animation for the staff roll.
・Guided Rocket’s vernier color changed.
・Changed Amelia’s animation when taking damage.
・Fixed a bug where, when defeating a boss, the briefcase sprite would be doubled. 
・Mr. Assault’s bag and umbrella position changed.
・Tweaked hit collision area for all enemies.
★Texture and lock-on camera tweaked for the last boss.
・Fixed a bug where the player was able to ride on top of an enemy.
★Fixed a bug where Officer Diamond doesn’t move in the Office Area.
・Shortened the time the button needs to be held down to trigger Kanoko Assist attacks.
・Fixed the display on the entrance to Dojo Mode.
・Changed position of Style Rank display.
・Changed the floor of the Executive Area.
・Relaxed the screen shaking effect a bit.


[h3]Difficulty level: Hard Work[/h3]
Unlock condition: Easy or Normal difficulty must be cleared.
*This difficulty level is unlocked separately for Asaru and Amelia.

[h3]Difficulty level: Extreme[/h3]
Unlock condition: Clear Hard Work difficulty.
*This difficulty level is unlocked separately for Asaru and Amelia.

[h3]Extra Mode: Death March[/h3]
Available from the start.

[h3]Extra Mode: Boss Rush[/h3]
Unlock condition: Clear both Asaru and Amelia story modes on Easy or Normal.

[h3]Extra Mode: ???[/h3]
Unlock condition: Clear both Asaru and Amelia story modes on Hard Work.

[h3]Extra Mode: Spy Must Die[/h3]
Unlock condition: Clear both Asaru and Amelia story modes on Extreme.

Asaru's Overclock's red color effect added to his umbrella and suitcase.
Just Timing blue color effect also added to umbrella and suitcase.

Added a UI element when not in battle that displays how many people have been rescued.
If a target is close, the icon will begin to flicker.

Added a UI element in the pause menu that displays how many people have been rescued.

Added an icon in the Skill Shop to display the refund option.

=

If you have any questions or concerns, always feel free to reach out to us on our Discord! discord.gg/nisa

Stay safe,
Daniel

notes.title: A New Agent Infiltrates the Dojo
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/1c1bf04f79a0b27b5d70a9c1c5864ec6819dd992.png[/img]

[h1]Agent Amelia Hits the Dojo[/h1]

The game's second playable character, Amelia, is now available to try out in Dojo mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/be2f392937dda7cd5ee818d418ef24347c79b665.jpg[/img]

Where Asaru's playstyle involves high-speed dashing and well-timed JUST moves, Amelia is a brawler with an aggressive play style. Make use of the invincibility she has on her attacks and get right up in your foes' faces! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/dfa9c922ced3effa28b20a24112b960452bc74a3.jpg[/img]

Practice her moves now, so you're ready to hit the ground running once her story mode is available!

[h1]New Death March Mode[/h1]

With this new update, we've added a new challenge mode to the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/577ca614d871329d23c89f53956aa56606e913c2.jpg[/img]

Death March is a mode where you fight your way through floor after floor of enemies as a timer ticks downwards. You gain more time for each enemy you defeat, and the higher your battle rank, the more extra time you’ll get! There are no checkpoints, so if you get a Game Over or run out of time, you’ll start over from the beginning.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/5bf63c04953e4fd1b877609aa918f4083d047414.jpg[/img]

Smash your way through battle after battle as fast and as stylishly as you can!

[h1]Guard Break[/h1]

A new Guard meter has been added to bosses and certain (tougher) enemies. Attacking these enemies from the front enough times will stagger them and allow you to go to town with your deadliest combos!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/00eba4e73b55125af8c54cbacb8f3e1501124519.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/420d74ca63c7be388b00b0d88108bb12f83238fd.jpg[/img]

However, take note that their Guard meter will regenerate shortly afterwards, so go all-out while you can!

[h1]Keyboard/Mouse Support Improved[/h1]

You can now rebind keys when playing in Keyboard mode. It also supports most non-English characters as well! :)

[h1]More Dojo Mode Options[/h1]

When in Dojo Mode, you can now press the Select button to call up a menu with additional options.

[h1]New Move for Asaru: Brainstorming Buster[/h1]

Asaru's Y+B move has been updated from previous versions of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/d06083722fdd2ec9be9b11d2fa054a5d0daf7867.jpg[/img]

Brainstorming Buster starts by slamming your unfortunate foe's head into the floor with a German Suplex, then rockets into the air with them, and finally drives them headfirst into the ground at high speeds (you professional spies out there may know this part as an "Izuna Drop")!

[h1]Bugs Terminated[/h1]

To make for a smoother spy experience for you, more bugs have been combo'd into oblivion!

notes.title: THE FINAL BOSS IS LEGIT AND MORE FUNCTIONALITY!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/eb759cc3f536393c9ef8faba06a5a9a3875f6bc4.png[/img]

Another update has been added to the Early Access build for Assault Spy! This update includes the final boss and thrilling conclusion to Asaru’s side of the story along with several quality of life additions that allow you to get right back into the action!

Check out a few of the key updates below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/5d652d02c48e747914d5023e5e7ca94fb6e0f5f8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Executive Area:[/h1]
After completing the Back Lot stage, you’ll finally reach the Executive area, where the masterminds behind the terrorist takeover have been hiding.., there is a new enemy you are to fight in this area but they have not been created yet. The current enemies in this area are a placeholder for now. However, please look forward to the final boss that has been added into the Executive Area.
 
[h1]Epilogue:[/h1]
When the final boss is defeated an ending cutscene will play. When this ending cutscene is complete, a “clear game flag” is added to your save file and you will be returned to the main menu. A ★ will appear next to your save file to show that you have completed the adventure! If you continue from this save file, you will start at the beginning of the prologue. 
 
[h1]Updated Function:[/h1]
A new function has been added to the Options Menu that will let you automatically skip cutscenes so you can get right back into the action! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/fa6e3ab0ad220e7221df37fce62106ccf70ad5c5.jpg[/img]

Thank you to all who have been playing through the Early Access version of Assault Spy so far! We are happy to have been able to improve this game so far thanks to your feedback and we are excited to continue working with you to make Assault Spy the best that it can be! Stay tuned for more updates in the future and we look forward to improving the game with you then!
 
To those who have not joined in just yet—don’t worry! You can still join Early Access now on Steam for a special discounted price for a limited time! Help take back the Negabot corporation today!

More update screenshots:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/dd82415deb4094797f2e46edb5fe3576e88ea38c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/d488d27ef950dee6fd63c0900e77616b2cc84c81.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/4a8197647e7452bfb8f6038e45ccb3616652da0a.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/a60cb5841051ccf120127666d5f3ef3dbe9b0e43.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/85a0f1b1abea3e09100da09270a93a5dff69a8b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: RUNNING AROUND THE BACK LOT
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/afe2413e228a3a24b7d3bd78cd6b083cb6d3a1f0.jpg[/img]

Assault Spy had another update today, and this time you have quite a few new challenges ahead of you. In this update, you’ll have to rely on not only your battle skills, but your instincts and patience too if you want to keep climbing up the company ladder. 
 
Your new update, should you choose to accept it, will have you face off against the following threats:
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/9d7784bae18f81ebb40c9cf640004e8cabdbdfde.png[/img]
 
[h1]New Area - Back Lot[/h1] 

The newest story segment takes place in a new zone: the Back Lot. In this area, you’ll encounter enemies and obstacles that will challenge you to use your skills differently. Can you overcome the ups and downs of the Back Lot?
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/c42457ca25fab030c572bbd6a1e38503891ecc2b.png[/img]

[h1]Stealth Levels[/h1]

When your weapons are taken from you, you’ll need to rely on a fundamental spy skill — stealth! In the newest update, you’ll find yourself sneaking and dashing around to avoid security cameras and guards as you traverse a set of levels designed specifically to test your skill! Can you escape?
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/5e390c527c88e49d2597c72b6b3bd1b1cde3c826.png[/img]

[h1]Enemy Upgrades[/h1]
 
The Monitor Man and Drone models have been equipped with the latest Negabot Tech. Be sure to watch out for some new tricks they’ve got up their sleeves. The game’s balance has been adjusted to introduce new challenges.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32030614/3a47f0404111b83965bb3eb38f26acba91c46660.png[/img]
 
Take on this new assignment now in Assault Spy on Steam, available for a special Early Access price. Dive into the world of corporate spy espionage today!
